title: Optimal Deep Nonparametric Regression with Uniformly Bounded Lipschitz Constants
abstract: arXiv:2611.23979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stability under input perturbations is necessary for deep neural network estimators in many applications involving noisy covariates or estimated features. Weight norm constraints are widely used to control sensitivity to input perturbations by bounding the Lipschitz constant of neural networks. However, existing approximation results under fixed bounds on standard norm products are insufficient to establish optimal statistical rates. In this paper, we establish a sharp approximation theory for deep ReLU networks under a split spectral norm product constraint. This theoretical result shows that sufficiently smooth H\"{o}lder functions can be uniformly approximated to arbitrary accuracy as the network depth increases, with the norm-product bound held fixed. translated_title: 具有一致有界Lipschitz常数的最优深度非参数回归
translated_abstract: 在涉及含噪协变量或估计特征的许多应用中，深度神经网络估计器必须具备对输入扰动的稳定性。权重范数约束被广泛用于通过限制神经网络的Lipschitz常数来控制对输入扰动的敏感度。然而，在标准范数乘积固定界下的现有逼近结果不足以建立最优的统计收敛率。本文在分裂谱范数乘积约束下为深度ReLU网络建立了一个尖锐的逼近理论。该理论结果表明，随着网络深度的增加，足够光滑的Hölder函数可以在范数乘积界保持固定的情况下被一致地逼近到任意精度。随后，我们针对深度非参数回归提出了一个带惩罚项的最小二乘估计器。所得估计器在具有一致有界Lipschitz常数的同时，仍能达到最优的统计收敛率。
tldr: 本文在分裂谱范数乘积约束下建立了深度ReLU网络的尖锐逼近理论，并提出带惩罚的最小二乘估计器，使深度非参数回归在保持一致有界Lipschitz常数的同时达到最优统计收敛率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a sharp approximation theory for deep ReLU networks under a split spectral norm product constraint and proposes a penalized least squares estimator that achieves optimal statistical rates for deep nonparametric regression while maintaining a uniformly bounded Lipschitz constant.
